promptSet.title: Nano Banana Editorial Photoshoot Prompts (4 Styles)
promptSet.description:
Prompt 1:
Create a high-resolution, wide-angle portrait of a man (use the uploaded picture as reference for the face) squatting on an outdoor basketball court during sunset. The man is positioned at the center of the image, leaning slightly forward with his hands clasped together between his knees, looking directly into the camera with an intense, confident expression.
He is wearing a black Nike t-shirt, gray shorts, and white sneakers. The background shows a beautifully colored sky transitioning from warm pink and orange tones near the horizon to cooler purples and blues above. Surrounding the court are blooming bushes with pink flowers, green grass, and distant trees, all softly illuminated by the sunset light. The camera perspective should be low and close to the ground, using a fisheye or ultra-wide lens effect that curves the court lines around the subject, adding a dynamic and immersive look. The overall mood should feel modern, energetic, and cinematic, blending street culture with natural beauty.


Prompt 2:
Ultra-realistic 8K photorealistic cinematic editorial image, 4:5. A man sitting on top of a red step ladder outdoors under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Full-body framing, subject clearly visible including legs and shoes. Pose: seated on ladder, body upright. Orientation: facing LEFT. Head tilt: slightly tilted upward. Gaze: upward. Expression: calm, relaxed, eyes closed or softly shut. Hairstyle MUST match the model reference: short, dark hair, neatly styled with slight volume, clean sides. Outfit MUST match the model reference: beige knit sweater with horizontal stripe details on sleeves, brown pants, casual sneakers. Lighting MUST match: bright natural sunlight, strong directional light casting natural shadows. Background: open sky with clouds, no additional elements. Replace the model's face completely with the provided user face, preserving exact facial identity, proportions, beard, and featuresfrom the user image. Blend seamlessly with lighting and angle. Do not retain any of the original models facial features. Camera angle: slightly low angle looking up. Maintain original composition and framing exactly. No creative changes


Prompt 3:
Ultra-realistic 8K photorealistic cinematic editorial portrait, 4:5 vertical. A man is seated on a chair, leaning back in a relaxed posture. Body facing slightly RIGHT relative to the camera. Head tilted BACK and slightly to the LEFT, chin raised (UP). Eyes CLOSED with a calm, serene facial expression. Replace the model's face completely with the provided USER FACE, preserving exact facial proportions, skin tone, beard, and identity. Hairstyle MUST match the reference model: short, dark, wavy hair with natural volume and slight curl texture on top, tapered sides. Outfit MUST match: white button-down shirt with top buttons open, sleeves rolled to forearms, slightly wrinkled fabric; dark trousers; brown belt. Tattoos MUST remain clearly visible on both arms and neck as in the reference.
Lighting MUST match: strong, high-contrast red studio lighting with dramatic shadows, red background fully filling the frame. Framing: mid-to-full body portrait, seated, hands resting naturally near thighs, chair visible, do not crop tighter than reference. Camera angle: slightly low angle looking upward. No accessories unless visible. No glasses. Environment: minimal studio setup with solid vivid red background.


Prompt 4:
Ultra-realistic 8K photorealistic cinematic editorial portrait, 4:5. Half-body portrait of a man, body angled slightly RIGHT, shoulders turned away, head turned back toward camera. Head level with subtle tilt, gaze directed at camera. Expression serious and intense with slightly narrowed eyes and gently parted lips, conveying calm, confident, brooding energy. Dramatic directional lighting with a cinematic red-toned studio background. A soft, focused key light illuminates one side of the face, creating sculpted highlights on the cheekbone and forehead, with the opposite side in soft shadow for depth and contrast.
Wearing a dark chunky knit high-collar sweater, partially zipped, with thick visible texture; collar upright framing the jawline. HAIRSTYLE: short, dense volume, textured and slightly tousled on top with clean shorter sides, natural flow. FACE REPLACEMENT: seamlessly match lighting, shadows, and head angle. Background: deep burgundy/red gradient with smooth falloff, no distractions. Camera: half-body, eye-level, no tighter crop than reference. Maintain ultra-realistic skin texture, natural imperfections, high dynamic range, and professional editorial quality.
instructions: Open Nano Banana or your preferred image generation model (Gemini, Midjourney, Flux).
Select from Prompts 1 through 4 (Sunset Basketball Court Fisheye, Ladder Sky Editorial, Red Studio Chair Pose, or Burgundy High-Collar Moody Portrait).
Upload your reference photo for seamless face replacement and likeness preservation.
Set aspect ratio to 4:5 for optimal portrait orientation and Instagram feed aesthetics.
